comment: The engine combination the frontend provisions, and ADR014's reviewed baseline. `engine_version` also names the managed environment's directory, so bumping it provisions a fresh venv instead of mutating the one in use. When `engine-requirements.lock` ships beside the frontend (release sdists / Homebrew), provisioning installs with --require-hashes. Optional Beangulp/Beanprice features are never in the base profile; `bea engine enable` installs them from the matching optional lock or version pin.

beangulp.notes: Needs the system libmagic library (python-magic). CSV import via --csv does not need this feature.

beanprice.notes: Quote fetching only; bea add price still records a supplied quote without this feature.
